decisions.reason: After already retaining it once, management is more committed to this prominently presented, flame-retardant curtain fabric with a strong fit to the firm's contract business, so it is unlikely to reverse course now.

This is a less prominently committed and somewhat niche decorative fabric, but because it extends the existing collection and has already survived one review, escalation of commitment still favors keeping it for another year.

Its visible commitment is limited and it looks specialized, yet as a design-led extension that has already been kept once, management would still be inclined to attribute weak uptake to slow market development rather than drop it immediately.

As a very recent launch with its own page and a versatile role across upholstery and curtains, it carries fresh public commitment and fits the firm's broad-range strategy, making withdrawal within a year unlikely.
